ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle A=65^\circ$. When $\angle B$ and $\angle C$ are folded as shown, if $\angle ADB'=35^\circ$, then what is the sum of $\angle 1+\angle 2+\angle 3$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}\\
From the folding, we know: $\angle B=\angle B'$, $\angle C=\angle C'$.\\
$\because \angle 3=\angle B+\angle 4$, $\angle 4=\angle ADB'+\angle B'$,\\
$\therefore \angle 3=\angle B+\angle ADB'+\angle B'$\\
$=2\angle B+35^\circ$.\\
$\because \angle 1+\angle 2=180^\circ-\angle C'GC+180^\circ-\angle C'FC$\\
$=360^\circ-(\angle C'FC+\angle C'GC)$,\\
$\angle C'FC+\angle C'GC=360^\circ-\angle C-\angle C'$\\
$=360^\circ-2\angle C$,\\
$\therefore \angle 1+\angle 2=360^\circ-(\angle C'FC+\angle C'GC)$\\
$=360^\circ-(360^\circ-2\angle C)$\\
$=2\angle C$.\\
$\therefore \angle 1+\angle 2+\angle 3$\\
$=2\angle C+2\angle B+35^\circ$\\
$=2(\angle C+\angle B)+35^\circ$\\
$=2(180^\circ-\angle A)+35^\circ$\\
$=2(180^\circ-65^\circ)+35^\circ$\\
$=\boxed{265^\circ}$.

图像描述：图中是三角形 ABC，A 在上方，B、C 在底边两端。左侧角 B 被沿折痕 DE 折起，点 B 对应到 B′；右侧角 C 被沿折痕 FG 折起，点 C 对应到 C′。图中标出 ∠1 在 F 附近，∠2 在 G 附近，∠3 在 E 附近，并给出 ∠ADB′=35°，且 ∠A=65°。

推理：设 ∠B=x，∠C=y。由于折叠保持角度不变，所以折起后的角满足 ∠B′=x，∠C′=y。右侧折叠中，展开 C′ 回到 C，可用四边形 C′FGC 的角度关系得到两个外侧折角之和为原角 C 的两倍，即 ∠1+∠2=2y。左侧折叠中，展开 B′ 回到 B，∠3 由两份原来的 ∠B 以及额外的 ∠ADB′=35° 组成，所以 ∠3=2x+35°。因此
∠1+∠2+∠3=2y+(2x+35°)=2(x+y)+35°。
在三角形 ABC 中，x+y=180°-∠A=180°-65°=115°，所以
∠1+∠2+∠3=2×115°+35°=265°。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, it is known that in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle A=65^\circ$. When $\angle B$ and $\angle C$ are folded as shown, if $\angle ADB'=35^\circ$, then what is the sum of $\angle 1+\angle 2+\angle 3$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:}\\
From the folding, we know: $\angle B=\angle B'$, $\angle C=\angle C'$.\\
$\because \angle 3=\angle B+\angle 4$, $\angle 4=\angle ADB'+\angle B'$,\\
$\therefore \angle 3=\angle B+\angle ADB'+\angle B'$\\
$=2\angle B+35^\circ$.\\
$\because \angle 1+\angle 2=180^\circ-\angle C'GC+180^\circ-\angle C'FC$\\
$=360^\circ-(\angle C'FC+\angle C'GC)$,\\
$\angle C'FC+\angle C'GC=360^\circ-\angle C-\angle C'$\\
$=360^\circ-2\angle C$,\\
$\therefore \angle 1+\angle 2=360^\circ-(\angle C'FC+\angle C'GC)$\\
$=360^\circ-(360^\circ-2\angle C)$\\
$=2\angle C$.\\
$\therefore \angle 1+\angle 2+\angle 3$\\
$=2\angle C+2\angle B+35^\circ$\\
$=2(\angle C+\angle B)+35^\circ$\\
$=2(180^\circ-\angle A)+35^\circ$\\
$=2(180^\circ-65^\circ)+35^\circ$\\
$=\boxed{265^\circ}$
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle ABC, A is above, B is at the lower left, C is at the lower right, and the problem stem gives ∠A=65°. The left side shows that after ∠B is folded, B corresponds to B′, and the endpoints of the crease are near D and E; the figure also marks ∠ADB′=35°, and angle 3 is near E. The right side shows that after ∠C is folded, C corresponds to C′, and the endpoints of the crease are F and G; angle 1 is marked at F, and angle 2 is marked at G. Reasoning: Let ∠B=x and ∠C=y. By folding symmetry, the folded ∠B′=∠B=x and ∠C′=∠C=y. According to the angle relations at D, E, and B′ on the left side of the figure, ∠3 equals the original ∠B plus the adjacent angle, and this adjacent angle is ∠ADB′+∠B′=35°+x by the exterior angle relation, so ∠3=x+35°+x=2x+35°. On the right side, look at quadrilateral C′FGC, in which ∠C′=∠C=y, so the sum of the two interior angles at F and G is 360°-2y. The ∠1 and ∠2 in the figure are respectively the supplementary angles of these two interior angles, therefore ∠1+∠2=360°-(360°-2y)=2y. Thus ∠1+∠2+∠3=2y+2x+35°=2(x+y)+35°. Also because in triangle ABC, x+y=180°-65°=115°, the required sum is 2×115°+35°=265°.
